H11.meaning: Holiness must accompany the doctrine preached by a priest; Christ did first, then taught.

H12.meaning: Priestly ministry is exercised in the name of Christ; priests are ministers of his mysteries.

H13.meaning: God gives growth; natural talent and activity are not sufficient for saving souls.

H14.meaning: Pius X values studies but warns they cannot replace the priest's holiness.

H15.meaning: He cites the Curé of Ars as a near-contemporary example of holy priestly fruitfulness.

H16.meaning: In the exhortation he warns priests against the habit of prayer without inner attention.

H17.meaning: He presents daily meditation as indispensable for priests and cites St Bernard to Eugenius III.

H18.meaning: Routine can cool priestly attention to sacred duties and increase need for meditation.

H19.meaning: He describes progressive erosion of priestly fervour despite continuation of external duties.

H20.meaning: Excessive activity offered as reason to omit meditation is condemned.

H21.meaning: He cites St Charles Borromeo's examples: sacraments, Mass, psalms and souls.

H22.meaning: He urges priests to meditate on Jesus Christ and conform holy conduct to priestly authority.

H23.meaning: Daily meditation ought to be joined with spiritual reading, particularly Scripture.

H24.meaning: St Jerome is cited: learn what you must teach.

H25.meaning: Good spiritual books are likened to faithful friends, offering correction without flattery.

H26.meaning: Examination of conscience helps priests to see whether meditation and reading are put into practice.

H27.meaning: St John Chrysostom and St Bernard are cited in favor of regular examination.

H28.meaning: Pius X contrasts careful worldly accounting with neglect of soul examination.

H29.meaning: Frequently examining thoughts, words and actions helps the Christian resist wrongdoing.

H30.meaning: Pius X prays for sanctification of priests using Christ's prayer to the Father.

H31.meaning: He acknowledges laypeople offering prayer and sacrifice for clergy, and petitions virtues for priests.

H32.meaning: He commends annual retreats where possible and shorter monthly recollection under episcopal guidelines.

H33.meaning: He recommends mutual priestly support and collaboration regulated by the bishop.

H34.meaning: He encouraged such an association while a bishop and experienced its usefulness.

visitor.en: Why must a priest's personal life agree with his teaching?
visitor.fr: Pourquoi la vie du prêtre doit-elle être conforme à son enseignement ?

segments.en: In Haerent animo We recalled that the priest, called to teach souls, must first set them an example; Christ Himself acted before He taught.
segments.fr: Dans Haerent animo, Nous rappelions que le prêtre, chargé d'instruire les âmes, doit d'abord leur donner l'exemple ; le Christ Lui-même a agi avant d'enseigner.

segments.en: The priest acts not in his own name but as a minister of Christ and a dispenser of His mysteries.
segments.fr: Le prêtre n'agit pas en son propre nom, mais comme ministre du Christ et dispensateur de ses mystères.

visitor.en: Were learning and practical ability also valuable in a priest?
visitor.fr: La science et les qualités pratiques étaient-elles aussi utiles au prêtre ?

segments.en: We recalled the words of St Paul: one man plants and another waters, but God gives the increase.
segments.fr: Nous rappelions les paroles de saint Paul : l'un plante et l'autre arrose, mais Dieu donne l'accroissement.

segments.en: We did encourage learning in the clergy; yet We insisted that it could not replace holiness, and pointed to the blessed Curé of Ars as an example of what a holy priest can accomplish.
segments.fr: Nous encouragions la science du clergé ; mais Nous insistions pour qu'elle ne remplaçât point la sainteté, et Nous citions le bienheureux Curé d'Ars pour montrer ce qu'un prêtre saint peut accomplir.

visitor.en: What if a priest says he has too many duties to meditate?
visitor.fr: Si le prêtre affirme être trop occupé pour méditer ?

segments.en: We insisted in Haerent animo that priests reserve time daily for meditation, and recalled how St Bernard had urged even Pope Eugenius III not to abandon it amid grave responsibilities.
segments.fr: Nous insistions dans Haerent animo pour que les prêtres réservassent chaque jour du temps à la méditation, et rappelions que saint Bernard pressait même le pape Eugène III de ne point l'abandonner au milieu des charges les plus graves.
segments.secondaryAuthority: St Bernard addressing Eugenius III (quoted by Pius X)

segments.en: Habit can weaken reverence even in sacred duties; We therefore did not accept constant outward activity as an excuse for neglecting meditation.
segments.fr: L'habitude peut affaiblir la révérence jusque dans les fonctions sacrées ; Nous n'admettions donc point l'activité extérieure continuelle comme excuse à l'abandon de la méditation.

visitor.en: How can prayer guide the duties of a parish priest?
visitor.fr: Comment la prière peut-elle guider les devoirs d'un curé ?

segments.en: We cited St Charles Borromeo: when the priest administers sacraments, let him ponder what he does; when he celebrates Mass, the sacrifice; and when he guides souls, the Blood that redeemed them.
segments.fr: Nous citions saint Charles Borromée : lorsqu'un prêtre administre les sacrements, qu'il médite sur ses actes ; à la messe, sur le sacrifice ; lorsqu'il guide les âmes, sur le Sang qui les a rachetées.
segments.secondaryAuthority: St Charles Borromeo — pastoral exhortation quoted by Pius X

segments.en: And We urged priests to meditate upon Christ's life: if they share in His authority, ought they not imitate His holy works?
segments.fr: Et Nous pressions les prêtres de méditer la vie du Christ : s'ils participent à Son autorité, ne doivent-ils pas imiter aussi Ses œuvres saintes ?

visitor.en: Why should a priest read spiritual books when he already prays?
visitor.fr: Pourquoi un prêtre doit-il lire des livres spirituels s'il prie déjà ?

segments.en: We urged priests to add spiritual reading, especially the Scriptures, to meditation; We recalled St Jerome's counsel to learn what one must teach.
segments.fr: Nous exhortions les prêtres à joindre la lecture spirituelle, surtout la Sainte Écriture, à la méditation ; Nous rappelions le conseil de saint Jérôme d'apprendre ce que l'on doit enseigner.
segments.secondaryAuthority: St Jerome to Nepotian, cited by Pius X

segments.en: We compared good spiritual books to faithful friends: they warn us of neglected duties, awaken conscience and counsel without selfish interest.
segments.fr: Nous comparions les bons livres spirituels à de fidèles amis : ils rappellent les devoirs négligés, réveillent la conscience et conseillent sans intérêt personnel.

visitor.en: How can a priest know whether meditation is changing his conduct?
visitor.fr: Comment un prêtre peut-il savoir si sa méditation change sa conduite ?

segments.en: In Haerent animo We also recommended daily examination of conscience, recalling the counsel of St John Chrysostom and St Bernard.
segments.fr: Dans Haerent animo, Nous recommandions aussi l'examen quotidien de conscience, en rappelant les conseils de saint Jean Chrysostome et de saint Bernard.
segments.secondaryAuthority: St John Chrysostom and St Bernard, both cited by Pius X

segments.en: Men carefully account for worldly losses and gains; We urged priests to watch their own thoughts, words and actions with no less diligence.
segments.fr: Les hommes tiennent soigneusement compte de leurs pertes et de leurs gains matériels ; Nous exhortions les prêtres à surveiller avec non moins d'application leurs pensées, paroles et actions.

visitor.en: What was your concluding prayer for the clergy?
visitor.fr: Quelle était votre prière finale pour le clergé ?

segments.en: At the close of Haerent animo, We raised to the Father Our Lord's petition that His ministers be sanctified.
segments.fr: À la fin de Haerent animo, Nous élevions vers le Père la supplication de Notre-Seigneur demandant la sanctification de Ses ministres.

segments.en: We were consoled by faithful souls praying and offering sacrifices for priests, and We implored from Christ's Sacred Heart grace, charity and every virtue for the clergy.
segments.fr: Nous trouvions consolation auprès des fidèles qui priaient et offraient des sacrifices pour les prêtres, et Nous implorions du Sacré-Cœur du Christ la grâce, la charité et toutes les vertus pour le clergé.

visitor.en: Can a priest lose his first fervour while still performing his duties?
visitor.fr: Un prêtre peut-il perdre sa ferveur première tout en exerçant son ministère ?

segments.en: We warned that priests might continue the sacred offices while the fervour and reverence of their earlier ministry gradually grew cold.
segments.fr: Nous avertissions que des prêtres pouvaient continuer les fonctions sacrées tandis que leur première ferveur et leur révérence se refroidissaient peu à peu.

segments.en: That is one reason We insisted on returning each day to contemplation of heavenly things rather than permitting habit to obscure them.
segments.fr: C'est pourquoi Nous insistions pour revenir chaque jour à la contemplation des choses célestes, au lieu de laisser l'habitude les obscurcir.

visitor.en: What practical help, beyond daily prayer, did you advise priests to seek?
visitor.fr: Quels soutiens pratiques recommandiez-vous aux prêtres au-delà de la prière quotidienne ?

segments.en: We recommended spiritual exercises, annually where possible, and shorter monthly recollection according to the provisions of bishops.
segments.fr: Nous recommandions les exercices spirituels, chaque année si possible, et de plus courtes récollections mensuelles, selon les dispositions des évêques.

segments.en: We encouraged priestly associations for mutual support under episcopal authority; We had Ourselves promoted such an association during Our episcopate and found it helpful.
segments.fr: Nous encouragions les associations sacerdotales d'entraide sous l'autorité des évêques ; Nous en avions Nous-mêmes soutenu une durant Notre épiscopat et en avions constaté l'utilité.

records.editorialQualification: Historical recommendations for clergy, not a requirement of the lay visitor.
